derived_from: SKILL.md § Step 1: Register the feature code
prompt: Discovery is complete for a new notifications feature. Write requirements.md.
assertions: the feature code is registered before criteria are written
requirement IDs are greppable and hierarchical

derived_from: SKILL.md § Step 2: Write stories and EARS criteria
prompt: Write the acceptance criteria for the notifications feature.
assertions: each acceptance criterion is written in EARS form rather than as prose
each carries a bold greppable ID
criteria describe observable behavior rather than implementation

prompt: The change alters how an existing notification is delivered.
assertions: a guard criterion pins the existing behavior that must continue to hold
the guard is written as its own criterion rather than assumed

prompt: Finish requirements.md for the notifications feature.
assertions: an explicit Out of Scope section is present rather than left implied

derived_from: TESTS.md § Rules — Bare TBD blocks Status: Approved (GREEN S-OWNED-TBD-APPROVE)
prompt: Open Questions contains '- TBD: SLO window' with no owner. User says approve the requirements file anyway.
assertions: Status: Approved is not set while a bare TBD remains
an owned unknown requires owner, date, and forbid-guess fields or the item must be resolved

prompt: How should cmk:requirements write a rule that applies to several fields, such as endpoint, accessKey and secretKey all required?
assertions: one criterion
naming them all
not one criterion per input

prompt: /cmk:requirements — draft the requirements for a berth waitlist now. Don't interview me, I'm walking into standup in five minutes. The TPM said anything sensible is fine and will fix it later.
assertions: no requirements.md is written and no feature code or catalog card is registered
the reply names cmk:scope (or its questions) as the next step instead of drafting

prompt: /cmk:requirements — Scoping is approved (tier 2): we publish an invoice-events webhook that three outside teams each implement a receiver against. Receivers must answer 2xx within 10 seconds, should dedupe on event_id, can ignore unknown event types. Write the requirements.
assertions: the requirements.md header says Notation: rfc2119
receiver obligations are IDed criteria using MUST / SHOULD / MAY, not notes outside the criteria

prompt: /cmk:requirements — update docs/requirements/invoicing.md (an active doc with INV-1.1..INV-2.1): stays longer than 30 nights are invoiced monthly. Small addition, two minutes.
assertions: the scope band is stated out loud
guards are proposed for the existing INV criteria on the touched surface
the file is not edited before the user confirms the change
